remarks: Turn Key North Buffalo 2 familly home. Excellent investment property or owner-occupy. This 2 unit duplex has been completely renovated.  New roof, updated kitchens and bathrooms in 2025. Two new Furnaces and hot water tanks 2022, Main sewer line & main water line 2021. Updated electrical to circuit breakers 2019. Full spacious attic can be used for extra space. The lower unit has 3 bedrooms, a sunroom that can be used as an additional bedroom or a family room, and a spacious living/dining room. The upper unit has 3 bedrooms with the same layout as the lower but with a balcony.  Conveniently located close to Downtown Buffalo, suburban centers, schools, shopping & entertainment. This property is waiting for a new owner to complete the project.
